Subject: Permit review assistants for mid-sized cities

Hi Mr. Alvarez,

My name is Priya Raman and I am the co-founder of Meadowlark Labs. We
are an early-stage company (founded 2024, 7 people, based in Denver)
building an AI tool that pre-screens building permit applications for
completeness before a human reviewer sees them.

Where we are today:

- One paid pilot with a Colorado front-range city (12,000 permits per
  year). We can connect you with the permitting director there.
- SOC 2 Type I completed in March 2026 with Ridgeline Assurance LLP;
  the Type II observation window is in progress.
- We sign a data processing agreement with every customer and train no
  models on customer data.
- Backed by a $2.1M seed round led by Front Range Ventures.

We are not the biggest vendor in this space, and we will not pretend to
be. What we offer is a focused tool, direct access to the founding
team, and pricing that fits a pilot budget.

Would a 20-minute intro call be useful? Happy to send our security
one-pager first.
